name: Odesa Opera and Ballet Theatre
scope: The standing 1887 Odesa National Academic Opera and Ballet Theatre, including its curved public front, projecting portico, flanking stair entrance wings and stepped auditorium and stage-house roofs.
era: The standing late-19th-century theatre as seen in the original photograph.

originalReview.notes: Original head-on image of the curved three-tier sandstone facade with a projecting double arch, paired columns, rustication and entablature sculpture.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Used the theatre's exact original front photograph from Qualla, which matches Assedo's first Wikimedia public-domain self-release.
